mapper.sql:
TO_CHAR(EL.APPLY_NO) AS APPLY_NO, TO_CHAR(EL.APPLY_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS APPLY_TIME, EL.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS FROM_DATE, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS FROM_TIME, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS TO_DATE, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'HH24:MI') AS TO_TIME, TO_CHAR(AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(EL.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'))) AS DAY_HOURS, EL.LEAVE_REASON, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE) AS LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(EL.LEAVE_TYPE_CODE, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS LEAVE_TYPE_CODE_NAME, EL.HR_COMMENT, TO_CHAR(EL.APPLY_LENGTH) AS APPLY_LENGTH, TO_CHAR(EL.AFFIRM_FLAG) AS AFFIRM_FLAG, TO_CHAR(EL.CONFIRM_FLAG) AS CONFIRM_FLAG, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(EL.AFFIRM_FLAG, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS AFFIRM_FLAG_NAME, HR.EMPID, HR.LOCAL_NAME, TO_CHAR(HR.POST_FAMILY) AS POST_FAMILY, TO_CHAR(HR.DUTY_NO) AS DUTY_NO, GET_DEPT_NAME(HR.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, GET_GLOBAL_NAME(GET_AR_SHIFTNO(EL.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(EL.APPLY_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), EL.CPNY_ID), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SHIFT_NAME, TO_CHAR(AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EL.PERSON_ID, '0') + AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EL.PERSON_ID, '4') + AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EL.PERSON_ID, 'LAST_YEAR_VAC')) AS TOT_VAC_CNT, TO_CHAR(AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, EL.PERSON_ID, '3')) AS SHENGYU_VAC_CNT, (SELECT LISTAGG(S.AFFIRM_LEVEL || ' [' || HE.EMPID || ']' || HE.LOCAL_NAME || '
', '') WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY S.AFFIRM_LEVEL) FROM SY_AFFIRM_EMAIL S, HR_EMPLOYEE HE WHERE S.AFFIRM_PERSON_ID = HE.PERSON_ID AND S.APPLY_NO = EL.APPLY_NO AND S.AFFIRM_LEVEL > 0) AS AFFIRM_STR, GET_UPDATED_INFO(EL.CREATED_BY) AS CREATED_BY, TO_CHAR(EL.CREATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS CREATE_DATE, GET_UPDATED_INFO(EL.UPDATED_BY) AS UPDATED_BY, TO_CHAR(EL.UPDATE_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI') AS UPDATE_DATE
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB EL, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE EL.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID(+) AND EL.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB ( APPLY_NO, LEAVE_TYPE_NO, LEAVE_FROM_TIME, LEAVE_TO_TIME, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, BATCH_YN, APPLY_TIME, ACTIVITY, SEND_EMAIL_FLAG ) VALUES ( #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '21', TRUNC(SYSDATE), TRUNC(SYSDATE), SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, SYSDATE, 1, 0 )
mapper.select: SELECT TO_CHAR(AR_GET_DAY_HOURS(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS'))) AS DAY_HOURS, TO_CHAR(GET_AR_LEAVE_LENGTH(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{toDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{toTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), #{leaveTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AS LEAVE_LENGTH FROM DUAL

SELECT GET_GLOBAL_NAME(GET_AR_SHIFTNO(HE.PERSON_ID, TO_CHAR(SYSDATE, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), HE.CPNY_ID), #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS SHIFT_NAME, TO_CHAR(HE.POST_FAMILY) AS POST_FAMILY, TO_CHAR(HE.DUTY_NO) AS DUTY_NO, TO_CHAR(AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, '0') + AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, '4') + AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, 'LAST_YEAR_VAC')) AS TOT_VAC_CNT, TO_CHAR(AR_GET_VAC_FOR_ESS(D.D_DASH, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HE.PERSON_ID, '3')) AS SHENGYU_VAC_CNT FROM HR_EMPLOYEE HE, (SELECT TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{applyDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS D_DASH FROM DUAL) D WHERE HE.PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND HE.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}

SELECT AR_GET_LEAVE_CLASH( #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI'), TO_CHAR(TO_DATE(#{toDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{toTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI')) FROM DUAL
mapper.update: UPDATE ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB SET PERSON_ID = #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLY_TIME = SYSDATE, LEAVE_FROM_TIME = TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), LEAVE_TO_TIME = TO_DATE(#{toDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{toTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), LEAVE_REASON = #{leaveReason, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, LEAVE_TYPE_CODE = #{leaveTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, APPLY_LENGTH = GET_AR_LEAVE_LENGTH(#{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{fromDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{fromTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), TO_DATE(#{toDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR} || ' ' || #{toTime, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY HH24:MI'), GET_CODE_NO(#{leaveTypeCode, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '21', #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'CODE')), AFFIRM_FLAG = 14014306, ACTIVITY = 1, BATCH_NO = 0, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CONFIRM_FLAG = 0, CONFIRM_DATE = NULL, CONFIRM_BY = NULL, CONFIRM_IP = NULL, CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SEND_EMAIL_FLAG = 0, MISDOCID = #{misDocId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO AR_SHIFT_CHANGE (NO, PERSON_ID, CPNY_ID, DATE_STR, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, END_DATE_STR, CHANGE_TYPE) SELECT AR_SHIFT_CHANGE_SEQ.NEXTVAL, HR.PERSON_ID, HR.CPNY_ID, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_FROM_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), 0, SYSDATE, TO_CHAR(EL.LEAVE_TO_TIME, 'YYYY/MM/DD'), '考勤确认' FROM ESS_LEAVE_APPLY_TB EL, HR_EMPLOYEE HR WHERE EL.PERSON_ID = HR.PERSON_ID AND EL.ACTIVITY = '1' AND EL.APPLY_NO = #{applyNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
